# New house swiper null protection and unstable key crash
SuZhuFang C new house carousel component lacked null protection and used index as key, causing item undefined error in WeChat mini program after video insertion.

## Symptoms and Root Cause
- Carousel rendered item.fileSite without null protection; detail.vue pushed items one by one with :key="index" unstable
- In WeChat mini program, inserting video shifted indices, making item undefined and triggering property access error
- Pattern shared across swiperComponent.vue, detail.vue and multiple house detail pages

## Solution
- Use optional chaining item?.fileSite in template to avoid null crashes
- Change key to item.fileSite || index instead of pure index for stable identity
- Assign this.allImg = mediaList in one shot in detail.vue to avoid intermediate push states

## Verification and Attribution
- Verification evidence: src=苏住房C/063.md
- Involved files: src/components/commonNew/swiperComponent.vue, src/pages_transaction/newHouse/detail.vue, src/pages/commonNew/swiperComponent.vue, src/pages_transaction/stockHouse/detail.vue, src/pages_main/houseMap/components/NewHouse.vue, src/pages_transaction/newHouse/houseTypeDetail.vue, src/pages_transaction/buildingAlbum/index.vue, src/utils/index.js
- Project: SuZhuFang C; source session: db12bfb7-5b5d-404f-93cd-258941957c3c; code baseline: none

# SFB login only stored V2 token missing V1 swap
SuZhuFang C SFB login logic only saved V2 token without swapping for V1 token, causing apiV1 requests depending on V1 token to fail.

## Symptoms and Root Cause
- After SFB login, interfaces requiring V1 token failed
- App.vue initSfbUser only saved V2 token, did not call getTokenV1() to obtain V1 token
- userStore.tokenV1 was not written, apiV1 requests lacked authentication

## Solution
- Immediately call getTokenV1() after setting V2 token in initSfbUser and write result to userStore.tokenV1
- Ensure subsequent apiV1 requests carry correct V1 token

## Verification and Attribution
- Verification evidence: src=苏住房C/064.md
- Involved files: src/App.vue, src/store/user.js, src/api/maintenance.js, src/api/security.js, src/pages/redirect/index.vue, src/api/index.js, src/api/v1Instance.js, src/pages/login/index.vue
- Project: SuZhuFang C; source session: cf09ca87-b417-43c0-b05d-5168f3aa3e55; code baseline: none

# 报修提交页onShow重载覆盖已选房屋
苏住房C市民端报修提交页在onShow中无条件重载房屋列表，导致从子页返回时用户手动选择的房屋被默认逻辑重置，报修挂错房屋。

## 问题现象与根因
- 报修提交页表单「所在房屋」从A切到B，点「报修设施设备」进入选择页，返回后房屋变回A，后续报修挂到错误房子
- submit.vue的onShow每次调getHouseList()重新拉列表，按优先级自动纠正选中项（userStore.houseId全局默认→当前小区房屋→列表第一项）
- 从子页面返回触发onShow，手动选择被默认逻辑覆盖；此类「onShow重载数据+表单默认值推导」组合必现且不明显报错

## 解决方案
- getHouseList内先判断form.house是否已有值：有则在刷新后列表找到对应项，补齐complexId/complexName/userIdentityId/houseId/position等联动字段后return，跳过默认房屋逻辑
- 仅用户未选过时才走默认优先级
- 同类排查：任何onShow/onActivated调用带默认值推导的加载函数都要检查是否覆盖已填内容，从选择类子页返回是最高发触发路径

## 验证与归属
- 验证：会话f5c3361f用户报切换房屋A→B返回变回A；定位submit.vue的onShow→getHouseList按默认重置；修复为data.house有值时按选中项回填5个字段并return
- 涉及文件：src/pages_owner_extra/repair/submit.vue、chooseFacility.vue、src/pages_owner/repair/submit.vue、chooseFacility.vue
- 所属项目：苏住房C；来源会话ID：f5c3361f-ac2a-43fa-8586-7a2d7934e203；代码基线：b7bf813

# uni-app自定义tab同时写v-model与@update致切tab不请求
苏找房页面切换标签时高亮变化但列表不刷新，因对自定义tab组件同时写v-model与@update:model-value导致监听被覆盖，逻辑未执行。

## 问题现象与根因
- 苏找房页切「推荐/新房/二手房」tab高亮正常，但列表数据不刷新、不发请求、控制台无报错
- 模板对ProjectTabBar同时写v-model和@update:model-value="tabChange"；uni-app中v-model编译的update:modelValue监听覆盖同名自定义监听
- 结果curTab被v-model更新（高亮切换），tabChange从不执行，$refs.paging.reload()不被调，列表接口不重发

## 解决方案
- 去掉v-model，只保留:model-value + @update:model-value="tabChange"单一数据流
- tabChange里写入新tab后在$nextTick之后调reload()，保证curIndex更新再触发分页请求
- 删掉手动this.houseList=[]，列表重置交z-paging的reload()统一负责，避免自动重置与手动清空打架闪烁
- 修完按tab核对请求：推荐listRecommend、新房pageByKeyWord、二手房houseInfoDisplayList

## 验证与归属
- 验证：会话6e707628用户报苏找房切换tag没调接口；定位Project_Suzhufang.vue第67行原含v-model；修复为去v-model、$nextTick后reload、删手动清空
- 涉及文件：src/pages/index/components/Project_Suzhufang.vue、menu/ProjectTabBar.vue、src/pages/index/project.vue、src/components/ZsPaging/ZsPaging.vue
- 所属项目：苏住房C；来源会话ID：6e707628-a295-466a-98ef-4fff34cf5423；代码基线：9832ba3
